title: ProblemProjection
description: The compact model-facing projection of one exact RFC 9457 Problem. The enclosing log row owns model-facing address and status; stable type, causal detail, and non-duplicative decision facts remain.

type.description: Absolute URI identifying the stable problem class.

detail.description: Specific, causal explanation of this occurrence.

stage.description: Stable producer-owned stage at which the operation failed, when neighboring stages imply different recovery.

recovery.description: One generally valid next action, only when the producer knows it.

retryable.description: Whether the producer recommends automatically retrying the identical request.
